newsitem.title: USA: FGIC qualifies four muni issues for bond insurance.
newsitem.headline: FGIC qualifies four muni issues for bond insurance.

text.p: Financial Guaranty Insurance Co said Monday it qualified for bond insurance the following four municipal issues scheduled for competitive sale today.
--Florida Department of Transportation, $44.335 million revenue bonds.
--Hewitt, Texas $1 million tax and revenue certificates.
--Montgomery County, Texas, $4.625 million certificates of obligation.
--Sachse, Texas, $1.14 million tax and revenue certificates.
